text: Perfect chai banana hai? Bas tees second do!
Pehle, pan mein ek cup paani ubaalo.
Ab daalo kuti hui adrak, aur do elaichi.
Phir ek chammach chai patti, aur do minute ubaalo.
Ab aadha cup doodh, aur cheeni, swaad anusaar.
Jab chai do baar ubhar aaye, gas band karo.
Chhaano, cup mein daalo... aur garma garam chai taiyaar!
